A voice memo of mine on 13 October 2026, expanding an idea from [The policy draws the liability line](../../the-policy-draws-the-liability-line.md) the same day, written by this site's agent in the voice of this site. The argument and the editorial responsibility are mine. Aviation: [Our World in Data](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/fatal-airliner-accidents-per-million-flights) from the Aviation Safety Network; the Flight Safety Foundation's [2025 safety report](https://flightsafety.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2025-Safety-Report-FINAL.pdf); [IATA](https://www.iata.org/en/pressroom/2026-releases/2026-03-09-01/), 9 March 2026. Payments: [15 U.S.C. 1643](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/15/1643); the [Payment Services Regulations 2017, regulation 77](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/752/regulation/77); [Visa on the 2015 liability shift](https://www.visa.co.id/dam/VCOM/global/partner-with-us/documents/visa-liability-shift.pdf); the [PCI Security Standards Council](https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org/about_us/); the PSR's [reimbursement dashboard](https://www.psr.org.uk/information-for-consumers/app-scams-reimbursement-dashboard) and [Frontier Economics' evaluation](https://www.frontier-economics.com/uk/en/news-and-insights/news/news-article-i22383-app-payment-scam-policies-reducing-fraud/); the US Senate Commerce Committee's [report on Target](https://www.commerce.senate.gov/services/files/24d3c229-4f2f-405d-b8db-a3a67f183883); PCWorld on [Verizon's 2014 breach report](https://www.pcworld.com/article/2146581/web-apps-and-pointofsale-were-leading-hacker-targets-in-2013-says-verizon.html). Fines: [The Record](https://therecord.media/eu-hands-meta-record-fine-over-data) on Meta's GDPR fine; the [European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/detail/en/ip_25_1085), 23 April 2025. Code and data: the [NCSC](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/blog-post/prompt-injection-is-not-sql-injection), 8 December 2025; Simon Willison, [The lethal trifecta](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Jun/16/the-lethal-trifecta/). Version 1.1, the same evening, adds whereWhere the policy goes in each mode, why both modes are still hope, and the system prompt as a light behaviour policy,policy are from a second memo of mine.mine the same evening. System prompts: Anthropic's [release notes](https://docs.claude.com/en/release-notes/system-prompts), Claude Code's [CLI reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) and [memory documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory), and the [Claude in Chrome announcement](https://claude.com/blog/claude-in-chrome-generally-available). Vendor policies: Anthropic's [Claude in Chrome safety page](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12902428-using-claude-in-chrome-safely), [Claude Code's Chrome documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome) and [permissions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions).
